title: FIBER MEMORY
description: A woven field can be combed directly with the pointer. Fibers retain the gesture, relax according to memory, and transmit twist across neighbouring strands so a stroke becomes a persistent material reorientation rather than a cursor effect.

visual_finish.composition: forty-two horizontal fibers occupy a dark textile field, with sparse transverse stitches making local combing legible at room scale
visual_finish.material_model: matte woven fiber with warm warp accents, dark interstices and persistent directional memory
